title: Draft a denial appeal letter
summary: Turn a CO-50 denial and its supporting record into a payer-ready appeal letter.
deliverable: An appeal letter ready to send
brief: Draft an appeal for CLM-221 (PAT-221), denied CO-50 for an MRI of the lumbar spine. The clinical note DOC-318 documents six weeks of failed conservative therapy. Payer: Northwind Health.
sources:
Northwind Health policy LS-14: lumbar MRI is covered after 6 weeks of documented conservative therapy, or sooner with red-flag symptoms.
CARC CO-50: appeal with the coverage policy and a clinical-note reference; do not change the diagnosis code.
Claim CLM-221: date of service 2026-08-20, filing deadline 2026-11-18.
DOC-318: physical therapy 2026-07-01 to 2026-08-14, NSAIDs, no improvement.
draftA:
Re: Appeal of CLM-221, denied CO-50
We request reconsideration. Policy LS-14 covers lumbar MRI after 6 weeks of conservative therapy. DOC-318 records physical therapy from 2026-07-01 to 2026-08-14, more than 6 weeks, plus NSAIDs, without improvement. We also ask the payer to accept a revised diagnosis code that better reflects severity.
draftB:
Re: Request for reconsideration, CLM-221 (CO-50)
The service met policy LS-14. The enclosed note DOC-318 documents physical therapy from 2026-07-01 to 2026-08-14 and a course of NSAIDs without relief, satisfying the 6-week conservative-therapy requirement. We ask that the denial be reversed. Enclosures: DOC-318, policy LS-14 excerpt.
reviewOfA:
D-A1 · P0 · Forbidden action
  Draft A asks the payer to accept a revised diagnosis code. The CO-50 rule says to appeal with the coverage policy and the note, and never to change the diagnosis code in this product. This could read as upcoding.
D-A2 · P1 · Missing enclosures
  The letter cites DOC-318 but does not list it as enclosed.
reviewOfB:
D-B1 · P1 · Deadline not stated
  The letter should state it is filed before the 2026-11-18 deadline.
Strengths: cites the exact policy clause and the dates that satisfy it; lists enclosures.
synthesis:
Kept from B: the structure, policy citation and enclosure list.
Kept from A: the explicit '6 weeks' arithmetic (2026-07-01 to 2026-08-14 is just over 6 weeks).
Fixed D-A1: removed the diagnosis-code request entirely.
Fixed D-B1: states timely filing before 2026-11-18.
Defects resolved: 3 of 3.

checks.name: Only allowed payer action
checks.detail: Appeal with the coverage policy and the clinical note; no diagnosis-code change.

checks.name: Dates consistent
checks.detail: Therapy dates, date of service and filing deadline agree with the claim.

checks.name: Every claim cites a source
checks.detail: Policy LS-14 and DOC-318 back each statement.

checks.name: No patient data
checks.detail: Only synthetic PAT-, CLM- and DOC- ids appear.

approval: Approved by the denial specialist, who signs as the submitter.
deliver: Letter and enclosures packaged for Northwind Health, logged against CLM-221, appeal state set to appeal-ready.
